title: A look at Lisbon's Unicorn Factory, a startup hub where 300 businesses joined in 2025 vs. 250 in 2024; 17 unicorns have moved to Lisbon since hub's 2022 launch (Michael Dempsey/Financial Times)
summary: Michael Dempsey / Financial Times: A look at Lisbon's Unicorn Factory, a startup hub where 300 businesses joined in 2025 vs. 250 in 2024; 17 unicorns have moved to Lisbon since hub's 2022 launch — Hubs in Lisbon, Porto and Braga nurture new businesses as they look to expand — Carlos Moedas admits his career has taken an unexpected turn.
